task.title: Link your Red Hat account to your company SSO for the first time
task.shortdesc: Use your Red Hat login to log in your Red Hat account when it is enabled to use company single sign-on (SSO) integration. The first time you log in, you must link your Red Hat account to your company SSO account.

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account.
Ensure your company account is set up to use company SSO integration.
Confirm that your Red Hat user account is not yet linked to your company SSO user.

prereq.note: This procedure is only required the first time that you authenticate, which is when Red Hat initially detects that your Red Hat company account has single sign-on (SSO) integration enabled.

step.cmd: Use your browser to navigate to access.redhat.com(or any Red Hat website or application)
Enter your Red Hat login. You are redirected to your company single sign-on login screen.
Enter your company credentials and log in.
step.stepresult: You are redirected to sso.redhat.com where a message appears for the next step: One-time account linking required.

step.cmd: Enter your Red Hat account password.

result.p: After a successful login, the avatar that is associated with your user account appears in the navigation bar in place of the login icon. Click the avatar for additional account information.
result.note: If the linking action fails, check that the Red Hat login and password are correct and are associated with the corporate account connected to your company SSO.
